content.title: Update/Group questions & answers
content.body:
Some questions should change the description of the options (good - bad) to something that reflects better the answers and whats is considered positive and negative. 

If a question covers the same subject and functionality/standard/requirement it should be grouped under one question. If necessary make the question broader and update the answers by override or changing the type.

**Refactor questions & categories:**
 - Rename categories according to proposal
 - Remove duplication of questions, group under broader question. Specially on low points categories, avoid low priority categories with too many questions.
 - Make the option of _not implemented_/_applicable_ as _very bad_ for some answers
 - Change question types to more relevant ones
 - Override options for exceptions to question types
 - Add the option of not relevant, making the comment mandatory to explain why, and updating the score to not affect positively nor negatively

Section analysis and proposals:
- Divide points into the categories, then distribute category points into its questions & check amount of questions.
  - **Code Readability** ~(Best practices)~ (s20, r20, m20) **60 points**
    - https://github.com/zakirullin/cognitive-load your code should be easy to follow, apply ideas from the cognitive load doc
    - Needs a bit more clarity and examples on the questions
  - **Application design** (previously Project set-up) (s20, m20, r10) **50 points**
    - Add Locality of Behaviour https://htmx.org/essays/locality-of-behaviour/
    - Need Architecture checks
    - State logic, how business logic is managed and keept understood
    - Bundler set up
    - Co-dependencies & coupling with other projects and within the project (are they necessary?)
    - API design of components and elements
    - Component / logic / UX logic division
    - Domain Driven Design patterns
  - **<Framework> Usage** (Technology stack, in this case VueJs) (r20, m10, s10) **40 Points**
    -  Group by official tech grouping example: vue templates, Reactivity, style bindings. Chapters on official documentation
    - Pinia, state management correct set-up
    - Vue ecosystem in general
  - **Dependencies** (r20, s10, m5) **35 Points**
    - Are dependencies up to date? Node version, main framework ecosystem versions, internal libs are updated
    - Uses bank deprecated libs and versions?
    - Uses unmaintained dependencies?
    - Deviates from standard libraries? are they justified?
    - Wasted dependencies: few usages from a huge library
    - Mixing normal, dev & peer dependencies
    - Override dependencies from your dependencies (example override vue2 from a dependency because your app uses vue3)
  - **Versioning** (m20, s10) **30 Points** (R)
    - Are the merged branches deleted?
    - Are old branches deleted?
  - **Testing** (s20, r10) **30 Points**
    - Are integration test present for all user scenarios? apply unit t. question to integration tests
    - Is mocking done correctly?
    - are waits avoided?
  - **Documentation** ~(Best practices)~, (m10, r10, s5) **25 Points**
  - **Static code analysis** (quality control) (m10, r5, s5) **20 Points** (R)
  - **Styling** (r5, s5, m5) **15 Points**
    - Include Tailwing
    - Emerald 2 usage
  -  To be deleted
  - **Security** ~(Best practices)~ (checks this one), (m5) **5 Points**
  - **Accessibility**: needs more questions, reach accessibility team, link with audit (r5) **5 points**
    - Did you perform a review?
    - Deserves a complete review?

content.title: Reduce clicks to answer a question
content.body:
- Remove expand functionality & button
- Move answer options to top bar
- Make sure explanation of the question is visible but not obtrusive
   - Under the qustion, smaller font, not too wide, not to tall
   - If explanation is too long implement a _read more_ or _pop-up_
- Hide textarea
- Add button below to add comment with type [Link](https://primevue.org/button/#link) no icon needed:
   - Clicking it shows the textarea
   - Autofocus on adding / editing
   - Autosaving on blur / exiting the texarea
   - Saving or stop editing the comment will make the text area look like plain text / preview of the comment
   - Once a comment is set, the add button becomes edit button
   - Certain options might have required comment and will open & focus the editor
   - When the comment is mandatory it doesn't close the edition until a comment was made and shows a validation error when empty

content.title: Update answer / explanations system
content.body:
Questions should be able to change the description of the options (good - bad) to something that reflects better the answers and whats is considered positive and negative:

Add the functionality:

On options custom messages overrides can be set, individually or per type of question: not implemented can be good or bad depending the question or question type
Some questions types where a lot is bad others where a lot is good
Booleans, ranges with different orders (implemented-good -> not-implemented-bad, used-bad -> not-used-good) & custom messages
Internally the score numbers should be preserved, this change should help to understand the question and answers, a rephrase of the question can also help in some cases.
The options should be a map/set of ordered scores and label descriptions, following src/components/base/RateSelect.vue idea
Overrides should follow the map/set format so only the desired values are overriden

content.title: Not applicable should be a secondary option from a menu and require explanation
content.body:
We want to give users an out when a question really is not applicable. This should not be too easy to find to discourage using it.

- Not applicable should be a option from a menu in each question (not part of the answers)
- The menu is only visible when a question is hovered
- When "Does not apply" is selected, show the explanation box
- Explanation is required
- Add a placeholder to the explanation area: "Please explain why it does not apply"
